desc: Derive the XOR/parity reduction and identify the DSU formulation and pitfalls.
Implement the full solution with fast input, weighted DSU, prefix parity scanning, row/column parity checks, and modular power output.
Verify on the sample and on edge cases (all A with odd row/col parity, all B, inconsistent B-label cycles, many small cases, and total HW=1e6 performance).
